name: intercom-lab
description: Single-purpose talkback bench for one Reolink doorbell: browser mic -> RTSP ONVIF backchannel, with nothing in between.

scripts.build: npx --prefix ../.. tsc ../../src/protocols/rtspBackchannel.ts ../../src/protocols/g711.ts --outDir build --module commonjs --target es2022 --lib es2024 --moduleResolution node --skipLibCheck && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('build/package.json','{\"type\":\"commonjs\"}')"
